QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Nella, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p406##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p406#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. Come to think of it, it would be a good idea to go say hi to #p406# as well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: So, you must be the adventurer who just became the newest resident of this city, right? How do I know that? Heh, I may not look it, but I'm actually pretty famous around here for being in the loop. If you're planning on staying in this city, that's something you'd better keep in mind.
1.1: You're wondering why I live here? Well, I just love this place. You get to live exactly how you want without caring about what anyone else thinks. Plus, I'm pretty quick at reading the room. Thanks to that, I know a lot of people around here and manage to keep a good relationship with them.
1.2: If you ever feel lost on how to survive in this city, coming to see me might actually help. I mean, who knows? I just might have a very tempting job to offer you.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
